final: WITH d AS (SELECT m.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member mb JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.department), s AS (SELECT department, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM d) AS share FROM d), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.department, s.member_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC
